subject: POC kickoff — finding overlapping hands-on windows across US/EU/APAC
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@brightretail.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Apr 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — finding overlapping hands-on windows across US/EU/APAC

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC. We want to make sure the kickoff and the prompt/runbook deep dives work for both your engineering team and your APAC storefront team. Given the three zones involved (US engineering, EU product, APAC ops) I propose we lock a set of rotating windows that let at least two zones attend live for the hands-on lab.

Suggested kickoff week: Apr 21–25 (we can be flexible). Here are two sets of rotating windows (all times shown with local conversions):

Option A (short blocks, better latency coverage)
- US morning / EU afternoon: 09:30 PT / 17:30 CEST (40–60m)
- EU morning / APAC evening: 09:30 CEST / 16:30 SGT (40–60m)
- APAC early / US late: 07:30 SGT / 16:30 PT (short overlap, 30–45m)

Option B (longer consolidated sessions)
- Long session (90m) covering US/EU overlap: 11:00 PT / 20:00 CEST (will also be late for APAC)

Asks:
- Can you confirm which days your platform and ops leads can join live?
- Do you have any hard blackout windows on Apr 21–25?
- Do you want us to run an initial prefix/load rehearsal prior to the kickoff (we recommend a 30-minute load smoke test two days before)?

I attached a short runbook (POC-runbook-v1.pdf) and a checklist. If you prefer, we can send a Doodle or a Calendly poll; I’ve also created a provisional calendar event (link below) so you can pick times.

Links: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=tri-region-poc-kickoff-20250418
Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b_poc-plan-redwood-brightretail

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Priya

Priya —

Thanks, this looks good. Sofia (cc) will co-own the EU side and I’ll loop procurement if we need a PO up front. Quick answers:
- Our engineers are generally available Apr 22–24 for focused sessions; Apr 21 is a maintenance day and is a hard no.
- Prefer Option A for shorter, focused blocks. For a full hands-on we can do 09:30 PT / 17:30 CEST on Apr 22 and 09:30 CEST / 16:30 SGT on Apr 23.
- We’d like the smoke/load rehearsal two days before Apr 20 — is that feasible? We expect to run a lightweight ramp to 50 concurrent users for ~20 minutes.

Question: for the hands-on prompt review, can you confirm which model variant you recommend for initial testing (FP16 or int8)? Also what’s the expected token budget for the session if we plan ~90 prompts per attendee?

I’ll confirm final attendee list by Monday and send procurement an estimate.

— Alex

Senior Engineering Manager — Bright Retail
alex.chen@brightretail.com

Subject: Re: POC kickoff — finding overlapping hands-on windows across US/EU/APAC

Alex / Sofia —

Perfect — thanks for the quick callouts. We can absolutely run the smoke rehearsal on Apr 20; Marissa (solutions eng) will own the load script and Karthik (SRE) will instrument the KV/cache knobs for the rehearsal.

Short answers:
- Recommended start: FP16 variant for the first day (better throughput + fidelity tradeoff). If we see good latency we’ll flip to int8 for the scaled load test on day two.
- Token budget: plan ~300–500 tokens per session per attendee if prompts average ~90 inputs and you want live retries + some context. Marissa will provide a tighter token estimate once we know attendee counts.

I attached a hands-on checklist (hands-on-checklist.xlsx) and the rehearsal plan. Proposed schedule updates (we’ll send calendar invites as soon as you confirm final attendees):
- Apr 20 10:00 PT — 20m smoke rehearsal (internal + Bright Retail staging)
- Apr 22 09:30 PT / 17:30 CEST — 60m prompt deep dive (FP16 variant)
- Apr 23 09:30 CEST / 16:30 SGT — 60m routing & prompt tuning (flip to int8 if okay)

If this aligns, I’ll lock invites and add a short pre-read to the doc.

— Priya

Attachment: hands-on-checklist.xlsx

All —

Adding a couple of practical notes from the engineering side before we lock invites:

1) Load rehearsal config: I attached a suggested YAML (loadtest-config.yaml) — it ramps to 50 concurrent sessions over 3 minutes, holds for 20, then ramps down. We’ll run that against your staging endpoint. Please share staging URL and any auth tokens.

2) KV / prefix caching: for the prompt review sessions we recommend enabling prefix caching for previously-seen templates (saves ~30–45% tokens). If you want strict parity we can keep caches off for the first 30m then enable for the later session.

3) Staggered window suggestion (to maximize live overlap):
- Day 1 (Apr 22): 09:30 PT / 17:30 CEST — focus on prompt design + routing rules (Marissa lead)
- Day 2 (Apr 23): 09:30 CEST / 16:30 SGT — focus on scaled routing and load rehearsal (Karthik lead)

4) Token estimate: if you have ~8 attendees and each does ~90 prompts, budget ~8 * 500 = 4,000 tokens per session as a ceiling. We’ll measure actuals in the rehearsal and report back.

Please drop the staging endpoint (or a short-lived token) into the shared doc and I’ll attach the load script there.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
